description: Check a hosted operation once, when the user asks how it is going or after a client restart; it never resubmits work. Do not call it on a loop while an operation runs: the review link shows progress as it is written. After a restart use the saved operation_id, or omit it to recover the most recent request, including a lost submission response. Polling is bounded to 20 seconds.
name: supportpages_get_operation
